prompt: 上周我们的 Agent 出了一个事故——一个工具调用进入了无限循环，连续运行了 11 天花了 4 万美金才被发现。我需要建立一套可观测性系统，确保类似问题能在 5 分钟内被检测到。

assertions.description: Defines a structured decision trace schema (JSON Schema or equivalent)
Includes a specific mechanism for detecting agent loops (not just step counting)
Defines cost spike detection with specific thresholds and time windows
Includes circuit breaker configuration (failure count, timeout, half-open behavior)
Design achieves MTTD < 5 minutes for the loop/cost scenario
